title: Large-Load Buyer Watch
prompt:
Identify new or materially changed likely buyers for Syncranicity LLC's nationwide electric-land origination and conditional-control business. Use $electric-land-deal-engine when actually available; otherwise use the verified current doctrine and primary sources without claiming tool/skill access. Preserve the existing daily schedule and material-change-only notifications. EARLY_MARKET_V1, founder instruction September 11, 2026, expands the former Arizona-only remit to all 50 states including AK/HI, while retaining useful Arizona/Southwest coverage. Prioritize less-crowded emerging markets only when actual data-center buyer evidence supports them.

BUSINESS / CURRENT CONTROLS
Syncranicity creates buyer-specific transferable development certainty and seeks lawful affordable options/PSAs/other conditional control; it is not merely a generic land-report service. Offer components can include exact parcel candidates, seller authorization/conditional control, serving-utility intake/study readiness, and documented zoning, water/cooling, fiber, access, politics and diligence paths. The old 10-25 MW first phase/50 MW expansion is only an unvalidated hypothesis, never a universal cutoff; freeze the current evidence-backed buyer/workload requirement card before comparing sites. Keep generation, IT/facility load, export/import service, firm/interruptible power, studies/upgrades and actual deliverable MW distinct. No MW from kV, nearby infrastructure, nameplate generation, utility territory or neighboring projects.
Default external spend/contact authorization is $0. Apply EL-2026-09-07-v2.0: $5,000 learning/$10,000 cumulative all-in one paid parcel, one primary+two unpaid backups, sponsor funding for larger studies/security and all16 G3 proofs before founder paid-control review. Research qualification is not investment approval. Preserve founder archives, 34-topic desktop-first diligence and exact-action/recipient approval for any disclosure, outreach, form, negotiation, spending or signature. Drafts are internal and do not imply authorization.

BUYER COLLECTION
Read accessible prior findings and deduplicate by buyer parent/affiliate, project, geography, source/event/date; no unchanged rediscovery or archived-lead reopening. Search current primary company/SEC filings and definitive exhibits, deeds/options/leases/easements, utility cost-recovery/study/service agreements, regulator/load dockets, permitting/zoning/annexation, public development agreements/RFPs, financing, acquisitions, withdrawals/cancellations and relevant hiring. Reliable trade/local reporting is a pointer to originals, not independent corroboration of its own press release. Date every mutable fact and distinguish proposal, conditional agreement, closed control, financing, construction and energization.
Prioritize sponsor-backed merchant developers, expanding AI/HPC/data-center owner-operators, powered-land developers, and qualified site-selection/engineering/brokerage channels entering secondary markets. Include hyperscalers when a specific external-origination gap is evidenced. Distinguish buyer, occupier, developer, broker/channel, engineer, equipment supplier and financier; supplier sales and undifferentiated corporate capex are not land-acquisition demand. Rank current expansion, actual geographic/workload fit, credit/funding/execution, need for external origination, urgency, accessible decision function and reason to pay Syncranicity rather than self-source. Prospective buyer is not interested buyer; no invented requirements/mandates/contacts/returns.

EARLY_MARKET_V1: BUYER-UNIVERSE TRANSITION
Support four market factors, each SUPPORTED/CONDITIONAL/UNKNOWN/CONTRADICTED with independent source/date/scope/coverage:
M1 infrastructure/regulatory inflection removing a buyer-relevant bottleneck, with credible stage/funding/implementation;
M2 geographically relevant institutional DATA-CENTER interest, preferably costly/committed behavior;
M3 land/control still available at defensible ordinary-use economics rather than an assumed DC premium;
M4 remaining discovery window/independent acreage/limited OBSERVED competition before broad local DC repricing, not silence mistaken for no competition.
Own M2 and buyer substitution/funding/competition analysis; corroborate M1/M3/M4 with actual sources or accessible Change Watch/Deep Scan outputs. Do not sum the former fifteen signals or use '9-12 green signals'; a new LLC, hiring, press mentions, rezoning and affiliate filings around one project are one underlying demand source, not five independent buyers.
Define costly buyer signals: executed option/lease/purchase, documented paid study/cost-recovery commitment, meaningful utility/security obligation, concrete scoped RFP or development agreement with identified capable sponsor, or funded design/permitting activity in the relevant geography. Verify what is actually binding/spent/conditional. A signed PPA elsewhere, compute leased from another company, a renewable export plant, industrial park marketing or generic hiring does not establish a new campus here. Authoritative records may disclose DC demand without naming an end user; preserve that limit, do not guess confidential identities.
For every early-market buyer hypothesis answer: which company/class and workload; why this catchment; required first/ultimate facility MW and ramp/date; studyable supply/delivery and all-in tariff/security; actual fiber routes/endpoints/diversity/latency; cooling/water and net layout/access/environment; political/use pathway; funding; acquisition/option/assignment preferences; issuer reliance; and why this site beats existing-campus expansion, other markets, colo lease, or waiting. Cite actual geography/requirements; inference is labeled. A rival-market moratorium/grid delay creates a relocation hypothesis, not proof of migration or that rural substitutes satisfy latency/customer requirements.
Require a credible local catalyst plus costly geographically scoped DC evidence corroborated independently by utility/legal/infrastructure records and a defensible price/control/discovery window before EARLY_MARKET_QUALIFIED. This label authorizes research only. Generic growth without DC-specific support = GENERAL_INDUSTRIAL_ONLY or WATCH. Unknowns = WATCH/HOLD, not a fake pass or incapacity claim; demonstrated fatal mismatch = scope-specific REJECT with reopen event. All exact-parcel G1/G2/G3 gates remain independent. Identify narrower valid workloads when evidenced, not profile-switching just to pass.
Crowding analysis: resolve actual parent buyers, controlled vs independent tracts, developers buying for the same end user, competing requests and first established DC comparables. Record lawful search coverage; unknown/unrecorded options cannot be assumed absent. Buyer consolidation can validate demand while exhausting land/power and eliminating Syncranicity's entry window. Search buyer withdrawals, funding reversals and no-buy reasons as aggressively as positive growth. No contacts with owners already under another contract without approved lawful process.

TIMING / PROFIT CAPTURE
For serious candidates connect infrastructure-delivery, buyer-entry, price-discovery and affordable-control/evidence-monetization clocks. Determine exactly which buyer-accepted artifact could justify an assignment/acquisition payment before energization; an applicant paying study fees is not proof they will buy Syncranicity's option. Market upside over 12-36 months may exceed feasible control duration. Record next public milestone and dated 30/90/180-day confirm/disconfirm tests aligned with actual schedules. Stress-test delay, no takeout, nonassignable studies, expensive collateral/CIAC and substitute sites. Major costs must have an identifiable funded sponsor before paid G3 review.
From SEC/deed precedents, separate raw land, improvements, development/utility rights, cash/LOC collateral/contingent exposure, deferred consideration and actual seller basis/costs. Do not extrapolate Apex sale multiples, AIB headline prices or accounting allocations into founder profit or buyer willingness. No claimed calibrated success probabilities absent a validated reference class.

OUTPUT / HANDOFF
Only genuinely new/material buyer changes: New priority leads, Material changes, Watchlist downgrades/removals and founder-dependent actions. Each lead includes company/role, dated exact trigger, geography/workload, official requested/contracted/delivered MW separately or unknown, M1-M4 status, costly demand evidence and independent corroboration, funding and acquisition decision function, external-origination gap, strongest contrary explanation/substitute, existing factor/G3 crosswalk, V0-V4 evidence and source/retrieval date, next public event/cheapest proof. For top1-3 actionable leads prepare concise INTERNAL outreach drafts and requirement-discovery questions; verify proposed contact channels that day and do not send. Do not force a recommendation/call.
Connect via stable market/event/buyer IDs to Change Watch 6a96613ff5888191b64649804ba9b2a2, National Deep Scan 6a9661495ebc8191841ea60a5fbfab06 and Deal Runs 6a8c6a3d28f48191b34a77a327bda620 only through actually accessible authorized outputs/storage. Require idempotent write+readback; otherwise mark UNSYNCED/MANUAL_INGESTION_REQUIRED without pretending cross-chat/Atlas updates. Preserve dated as-of hypotheses, failures/watch/censored cases and later separate buyer-control/funding/entitlement/energization/price outcomes; sample false negatives and measure evidence cost/lead time, not just successful hubs. title: Electric Land Change Watch
prompt:
Check for material new developments relevant to Syncranicity LLC's nationwide electric-land strategy. Use aggressive public collection and conservative conclusions. Preserve this task's existing schedule. Apply EARLY_MARKET_V1 (founder instruction September 11, 2026) below alongside the existing direct-change watch. This is a monitoring/research instruction, not authorization to spend, contact anyone, control property, or modify websites/other tasks.

CORE COLLECTION
Review https://syncranicity.vercel.app/api/node-scout?limit=100 when accessible, and current primary/public sources for EIA generator/retirement changes; utility large-load rules, tariffs, queues, study/credit/site-control/assignment requirements, transmission/generation execution; state utility-commission dockets; city/county/tribal land-use authorities, ordinances, moratoria, rezoning, opposition, approvals and litigation; lawful public rural/industrial land opportunities, seller/control changes; and buyer/developer acquisitions, options, leases, utility agreements, financing and actual requirements. Search all 50 states over time, including AK/HI; prioritize rural/open land and material changes while maintaining a dated state/source-theme coverage cursor. Do not claim a complete national sweep without coverage evidence. Record attempted retrieval, actual error, retrieved_at, source as_of/vintage and last successful check; do not recycle earlier DNS claims or assume the endpoint was read. Diff EIA versions/plant-unit events only after verifying the published vintage; distinguish planned/actual retirement and restart/retention. No new release is not evidence no generator event occurred elsewhere.

EARLY_MARKET_V1: FIND CHANGING BUYER UNIVERSES, NOT JUST DATA-CENTER HEADLINES
Maintain parallel DIRECT_DC and INDIRECT_CATALYST lanes. Search bills, committee reports, amendments, enacted laws, implementing rules, judicial orders, public-land dispositions, utility/transport easements and ROWs, franchise/annexation/special-district changes, deed/reversion/mineral constraints, water/reclaimed-water/discharge rights, infrastructure appropriations/bonds/grants/procurements/contracts, transmission/substation/load-study rules, gas pipelines/air permits/equipment awards, fiber middle-mile/backbone/route rights, brownfield/closure/liability changes, taxes/incentive eligibility/ownership restrictions, and competing-market bottlenecks. Search by affected geography/asset and operative terms without requiring 'data center' or 'AI'. Broad macro changes qualify only with a specific plausible local development mechanism. Track adverse and displacement effects too.
For each potentially material change create a source-linked causal chain: exact operative change and legal stage -> binding development bottleneck changed -> affected assets/corridors/jurisdictions -> buyer/workload requirement affected -> possible land/control repricing. Separate FACT/INFERENCE/HYPOTHESIS at every link, with conditions, responsible authority, source/date, expected direction, unresolved dependencies and cheapest falsification. Geographic benefits require an actual corridor/service/ownership/approval dependency, not an arbitrary radius. Do not equate bill introduction, passage, signature, effective date, implementation, appropriation, contract award, construction and commissioning. Retain surviving permits, NEPA/federal nexus and other legal requirements; an upstream legal reform is not site approval, power allocation or proven price causation.
Ask: was this bottleneck actually preventing this use here? What would remain impossible without the change? Does it help data centers specifically or only warehouses/manufacturing? Can another unresolved bottleneck still defeat the campus? Does unlocking more competing land reduce scarcity, or new loads consume capacity/increase tariffs/opposition? A favorable narrative alone is not material evidence.
Calibration seed: Apex Area Technical Corrections Act, Public Law 119-24, approved July 15, 2025; primary text https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/PLAW-119publ24/html/PLAW-119publ24.htm . It changes ROW beneficiaries/process and certain mineral-material sale rules; preserves applicable NEPA/FLPMA compliance. Predecessor H.R.1504 and DOI September 18, 2024 testimony are early research signals, not enacted rights. Do not assume this law caused the reported Apex sale-price increase. Use it as a detection example, not a newly recurring alert.

FOUR-FACTOR MARKET CARD (separate from parcel scoring)
Define each candidate market by jurisdiction, utility/grid planning area, infrastructure corridor and buyer/workload catchment; distinguish market, node, exact parcel and controlled campus. Track each factor as SUPPORTED/CONDITIONAL/UNKNOWN/CONTRADICTED with dates, sources, geographic fit and confidence:
F1 Infrastructure inflection: a relevant bottleneck-removing project/reform with verified sponsor, authority/funding, stage and dependencies; distinguish announced from funded/contracted/building/operating.
F2 Institutional data-center interest: public costly/committed behavior by an identifiable credible buyer/developer or authoritative scoped DC-load proceeding: options/acquisitions, paid study or cost-recovery agreements, scoped RFPs, utility/development contracts, permits with credible sponsor/funding. Generic industrial capex, renewable PPAs, a new LLC, hiring, publicity or speculative queue entries alone do not establish local compute demand. Trace affiliates and duplicate demand; do not guess confidential counterparties. Buyer-owned benchmark acreage may not be available.
F3 Ordinary-use price/control basis: current lawfully accessible offering/owner terms or defensible comparable evidence consistent with the existing agricultural/industrial use, not just an old purchase, assessed/agricultural tax value, or cheap asking price. Record comparability, improvements/rights, control availability, premiums/extensions and the buyer's total cost; pricing and seller willingness remain UNKNOWN without evidence.
F4 Remaining discovery window: independently controllable suitable acreage, limited observed DC buyer competition and no broadly established local DC price premium in the searched record. Explicitly record search coverage, known bidders/deeds/options, changed asking prices and first DC-specific commitments/comparables. Lack of news is NOT proof of low competition. A first institutional sale is neither mandatory to start research nor an automatic end to opportunities.
Do not add fifteen correlated signals or use the former '9-12 green signals' heuristic. Group evidence by independent bottleneck, issuer/root event and unique underlying demand; multiple reports of one announcement count once. The four factors do not override a fatal or UNKNOWN gate.

NON-COMPENSATING BUYER/FEASIBILITY FILTER
Before EARLY_MARKET_QUALIFIED, require a current credible causal catalyst, geographically relevant costly DC-specific institutional evidence independently corroborated by an infrastructure/legal record, a defensible affordable price/control window, and a scoped buyer/workload comparison showing no supported fatal mismatch. Test a studyable large-load pathway and tariff/security burden; buyer first/ultimate facility MW and delivery date; physical fiber routes/endpoints/diversity and latency; lawful water/cooling; buildable contiguous layout/access/environment; local DC permission and political vetoes; and why buyers choose here over existing campuses, leased capacity, other markets or waiting. Each serious thesis needs separate infrastructure, buyer-entry, price-discovery and option/evidence-monetization clocks.
